nonBlockingObservations.observation: Describe the vcs:none seam as entering the link stage with a supplied admitted-member set, rather than literally bypassing only item 6b. A real tree without .git also fails placement M2 before 6b. The stated link-stage scope and explicit no-production-membership claim make the intended control sound; its implementation should not add a production placement bypass or claim to test membership admission.

Section 4.1 still includes reader carriers and provider manifests in its total bound, while 4.2 names that bound the member term and 4.3 adds the separate reader term. In the B3-b3a derivation, explicitly partition the terms or subtract the reader component from the member term so the same charge is not counted twice. Conservative overlap cannot produce a false passing margin, so this does not block the plan; it can cause unnecessary cap failures and must be visible in the reviewed formula.
